item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Uses a partitioned window count and DISTINCT to retain one row per hour, including the NULL group, with the original DuckDB types and duplicate counts.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Enumerates distinct hours and counts each using NULL-safe correlation, preserving the original hour and COUNT(*) types.","sql":"SELECT h.hour AS hour, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips AS t WHERE EXTRACT(hour FROM t.tpep_pickup_datetime) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM h.hour) AS trips FROM (SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour FROM trips) AS h"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Keeps the exact day predicate and uses window counting with DISTINCT, preserving NULL routes, duplicate counts, anomalous dates, and original output types.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Enumerates eligible routes and counts them through NULL-safe correlation while retaining the exact date predicate and original output types.","sql":"WITH eligible AS (SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) SELECT r.pickup AS pickup, r.dropoff AS dropoff, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible AS e WHERE e.pickup IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.pickup AND e.dropoff IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.dropoff) AS trips FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pickup, dropoff FROM eligible) AS r"}]}
